purpose: Teach prevention; teach 感染/拒否/対処/防衛/認定/形態/青年/実質

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 今日は感染症の予防について話します。
lines.en: Today I’ll talk about preventing infectious disease.
lines.style: doctor opening the lecture, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 検査を拒否する人が多いと聞きます。
lines.en: I hear many people refuse testing.
lines.style: engaged student raising a point, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 早く対処すれば、重症化を防げます。
lines.style: doctor emphasizing timeliness, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 体の防衛機能を強くするには？
lines.en: How do you strengthen the body’s defenses?
lines.style: student seeking practical advice, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 睡眠と栄養です。難病に認定される前に予防を。
lines.en: Sleep and nutrition. Prevent before it’s certified as serious.
lines.style: doctor giving concrete guidance, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 病気の形態によって、対策も違いますよね。
lines.en: Measures differ by the disease’s form, right?
lines.style: student showing nuance, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: その通り。特に青年期は無理をしがちです。
lines.en: Exactly. Young people especially tend to overdo it.
lines.style: doctor cautioning the audience, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 実質、生活習慣が健康を決めるんですね。
lines.style: student landing the takeaway, tone holding steady through the whole line
